derivations.transformation: bounded adaptation. producer.skill set to devforge-release; the generic 'Observed verification' table replaced by the release-specific delivery table carrying the five delivery rows plus hosted CI; filling directions rewritten for this workflow; a 'Published' line added to the result block so the prepared-versus-published distinction survives a skim. The shared rules are preserved verbatim in substance: no self-digest, the handoff does not list itself among its outputs, hash only after bytes are final, the fixed result vocabulary, and the requirement to name only an installed skill or a plain task in the copyable prompt.
derivations.meaning_preserved: Every obligation of the shared template survives, but not every heading does. Two sections were folded rather than copied: 'What changed and what remains open' into the Result, Why and Limits lines, and 'Continuation directory' into the Next line and the copyable task. One section not in the shared template was added: 'Evidence and reading order', following the builder package's own handoff shape, so a receiver gets a reading order into the detailed records instead of a second copy of them. Nothing was dropped and no obligation was weakened; the mapping is stated here so a reader comparing the two files can see why the headings differ.

runtime_dependencies.boundary: The runner and graders are the framework's permitted Python evaluation artifacts: they produce evidence and metrics, not admission, acceptance or a verdict. Their MATCH / MISMATCH / INDETERMINATE vocabulary is deliberately disjoint from PASS / FAIL, and no row may be copied into a results record as an outcome. evals/ is an authoring input, never a runtime resource of this skill.
